https://cameronrwolfe.substack.com/p/automatic-prompt-optimization
Comprehensive survey covering APE (single-pass 64 candidates, diminishing returns beyond), APO (natural language gradients with beam search B candidates N edits, bandit selection, up to 31% improvement), OPRO (gradient-free iterative, K candidates per step, meta-prompt with sorted history, 8-50% improvement), GRIPS (heuristic phrase edits: delete/swap/paraphrase/add, greedy termination after K non-improving steps). All optimize against fixed training sets with overfitting risk. Scoring: accuracy for classification, LLM-as-evaluator for complex tasks.
